## Summary
<!-- Please describe what problems your PR addresses. -->
This basically updates the type definition of `BillLineItem` since we [updated the backend ](https://github.com/openmrs/openmrs-module-billing/pull/170) for a bill line item’s status type. The most important thing here, is that a bill line item will no longer return a property called `paymentStatus` but rather just `status`.
